blocks.text: Taqreeban tamam cnidarians marine hain, agarche kuch meethe paani mein bhi milte hain, jaise hydra aur (kitab ke mutabiq) jellyfish. Zyada tar cnidarians colonial (basti bana kar rehne wale) hain, jaise obelia, corals aur sea fans. Zyada tar sessile hain, yani ek jagah jure rehte hain, jaise hydra, coral aur obelia. Kuch motile hain, yani harkat karte hain, jaise jellyfish.

Cnidarians radially symmetrical aur diploblastic hain: baalig jism mein do tissue layers hoti hain, epidermis aur gastrodermis, jo ba-tarteeb ectoderm aur endoderm se banti hain. In dono ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea hoti hai jis mein amoeboid cells hote hain jo ectoderm ya endoderm se aate hain. Cnidarians mein khaas cells hote hain jinhein cnidocytes kehte hain. Har cnidocyte mein ek khaas organelle, nematocyst, hota hai jo jism ki hifazat karta hai aur shikaar (prey) pakarta hai. Cnidarians mein ek band sire wali (blind-ending) cavity hoti hai jise gastrovascular cavity ya enteron kehte hain. Yeh sirf ek soorakh, mouth, se bahar khulti hai. Mouth hi anus ka kaam bhi karta hai, yani bina hazam hua maadda bhi isi se nikalta hai. Mouth ke gird lambe ubhaar hote hain jinhein tentacles kehte hain. Aisa digestive system jis mein khana andar aane aur fuzla bahar jaane ka ek hi rasta ho, sac-like (thaili jaisa) digestive system kehlata hai.
Corals colonial cnidarians hain. Yeh calcium carbonate ka sakht exoskeleton banate hain. Yahi skeleton jama ho kar coral islands aur coral reefs banata hai.

blocks.alt: Paani ke andar ka manzar: upar baayen neela paani, daayen taraf ek bara grey-hara coral ka teela, aur neeche har taraf chhote gol corals.
blocks.caption: Coral reef (kitab ke 'Corals are colonial cnidarians' box ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka)

blocks.text: Nervous system body wall mein neurons ka ek jaal (network) hai; central nervous system (dimagh aur spinal cord) nahi hota. Cnidarians mein respiratory, excretory aur transport systems nahi hote. In ki do body forms hain: polyps aur medusae. Polyps cylinder (belan) jaise hote hain aur apne aboral sire (mouth se ulti taraf) se kisi satah (substrate) ke saath jure rehte hain; yeh asexual reproduction karte hain. Medusae chhatri jaise hote hain aur aazadi se tairte hain; yeh sexual reproduction karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen: Hydra, kaale par peela-hara polyp jis ke lambe patle tentacles aur ek taraf bud (kali) hai. Beech mein: Obelia, safed par hari shaakhdaar colony jis par chhote pyaale jaise polyps hain. Daayen upar: Sea anemone, gulabi tentacles se ghira disc; neeche: Jellyfish, gehre neele par halki gulabi ghanti (bell) jis se baazu aur dhaage latak rahe hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Hydra, Obelia, Sea anemone, Jellyfish.

blocks.alt: Cnidarians ki do jismani shaklein, lambai mein kati hui. Baayen: polyp, neeche se chattan se jura hua, upar mouth jis ke gird tentacles hain. Daayen: medusa, chhatri (bell) jaisa, kinare se tentacles latakte hain aur mouth neeche ki taraf beech mein hai. Dono mein bahar epidermis, darmiyan mesoglea aur andar gastrodermis hai jo gastrovascular cavity ko gherti hai.
blocks.caption: Polyp aur medusa: cnidarians ki do jismani shaklein (hamara samjhane wala khaaka; kitab mein yeh diagram nahi).
blocks.long_description: Dono shaklon mein ek hi soorakh, mouth, gastrovascular cavity mein khulta hai. Polyp mein mesoglea patli hai; medusa ki chhatri mein mesoglea moti jelly jaisi hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Polyp aur medusa ek hi banawat ki do shaklein hain. Polyp ko ulta kar dein to woh medusa jaisa lagta hai: polyp ka mouth upar hai aur woh ek jagah jura rehta hai, medusa ka mouth neeche hai aur woh tair kar chalta hai. Dono mein sirf do tissue layers hain, epidermis (neela) aur gastrodermis (hara); in ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea (peeli) hai. Khurak aur fuzla dono isi ek mouth se guzarte hain (sac-like digestive system).

blocks.alt: Cnidarians ki do body forms saath saath 3D model mein. Baayein polyp: ek seedha belan jo neeche se jura hai, aur upar mouth ke gird tentacles ka halqa. Daayein medusa: chhatri jaisi ghanti jis ka mouh neeche ki taraf hai, aur kinaron se tentacles latak rahe hain. Dono ko kaat kar do body layers aur darmiyani gastrovascular cavity dikhai gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Polyp aur medusa, cnidarians ki do body forms (asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Polyp ek sessile belan hai jis ka mouth aur tentacles upar ki taraf hote hain. Medusa wahi body plan ulta aur chapta kar ke azad tairne wali ghanti ban jata hai, jis ka mouth neeche ki taraf hota hai. Dono mein bahar epidermis, andar gastrodermis, darmiyan mein mesoglea aur ek gastrovascular cavity hoti hai.

fallback.text: Polyp: belan jaisa, jura hua, asexual. Medusa: chhatri jaisa, azad tairta, sexual.
